text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 8, January 02, 1936 ]
ENFORCING THE PROVISIONS OF THE CONSTITUTION ON THE CIVIL SERVICE
WHEREAS section one of Article XI of the Constitution of the Philippines provides as follows:
“A Civil Service embracing all branches and subdivisions of the Government shall be provided by law.
Appointments in the Civil Service, except as to those which are policy-determining, primarily confidential or
highly technical in nature, shall be made only according to merit and fitness, to be determined as far as
practicable by competitive examination”; and
